//@version=6
indicator("Strong Pressure Signals", overlay = true, max_boxes_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_bars_back = 2000)

gB = "01 · Burst Engine (signal source)"
srcIn      = input.source(close, "Basis source", group = gB)
basisType  = input.string("EMA", "Basis type", options = ["EMA", "SMA", "HMA", "WMA", "VWMA", "RMA"], group = gB)
basisLen   = input.int(20, "Basis length", minval = 2, maxval = 400, group = gB)
atrLen     = input.int(14, "ATR length", minval = 2, maxval = 200, group = gB)
bandMult   = input.float(2.0, "Band width (ATR beyond basis = burst starts)", minval = 0.2, maxval = 10.0, step = 0.1, group = gB, tooltip = "A bar bursts when its high pokes above basis + this·ATR (or its low below basis − this·ATR).")
stepATR    = input.float(0.5, "ATR per stack step", minval = 0.1, maxval = 3.0, step = 0.05, group = gB)
maxLevels  = input.int(6, "Max stack height", minval = 1, maxval = 6, group = gB)
heatSat    = input.float(3.0, "Heat saturates at (ATR beyond band)", minval = 0.5, maxval = 12.0, step = 0.5, group = gB)
needClose  = input.bool(false, "Require closing burst (close beyond band)", group = gB)
confirmBar = input.bool(true, "Confirm on bar close (non-repaint)", group = gB, tooltip = "ON: burst peaks are only detected on closed bars, so nothing repaints.")

gP = "02 · Pressure Clusters (liquidation fuel)"
clSide     = input.string("Both", "Cluster side", options = ["Both", "Longs Only (below)", "Shorts Only (above)"], group = gP, tooltip = "Long-liquidation clusters sit UNDER price at swing lows (support magnets). Short-liquidation clusters sit ABOVE at swing highs (resistance magnets).")
leftBars   = input.int(12, "Pivot left", minval = 1, group = gP)
rightBars  = input.int(4,  "Pivot right", minval = 1, group = gP)
lookbackW  = input.int(3000, "Lookback (bars, 0 = all)", minval = 0, group = gP)
maxZones   = input.int(30, "Max live clusters", minval = 2, maxval = 60, group = gP)
maxLife    = input.int(400, "Max cluster age (bars)", minval = 10, group = gP)
clMinMag   = input.float(0.0, "Min magnitude to keep (0-1)", minval = 0.0, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.05, group = gP)
hideOverlap= input.bool(true, "Merge overlapping clusters", group = gP)
overlapThr = input.int(35, "Overlap threshold (%)", minval = 1, maxval = 100, group = gP)
clAtrLen   = input.int(200, "Cluster ATR length (band + sweeps)", minval = 1, maxval = 500, group = gP)
bandATR    = input.float(0.5, "Band height (ATR mult)", minval = 0.05, maxval = 6.0, step = 0.05, group = gP, tooltip = "Invisible band around each cluster used for touch / sweep detection.")
minDepth   = input.float(0.15, "Min sweep depth (ATR)", minval = 0.02, maxval = 4.0, step = 0.01, group = gP)
reclaimWin = input.int(6, "Max reclaim window (bars)", minval = 1, maxval = 40, group = gP)
breakAtr   = input.float(0.9, "Decisive break acceptance (ATR)", minval = 0.1, maxval = 8.0, step = 0.1, group = gP)
flipBroken = input.bool(true, "Flip broken clusters (breakers)", group = gP)
magWeight  = input.float(0.7, "Magnitude weight in cluster strength", minval = 0.0, maxval = 1.0, step = 0.05, group = gP)
weightLB   = input.int(1000, "Magnitude lookback (bars)", minval = 100, maxval = 5000, group = gP)
magContrast= input.float(0.6, "Magnitude contrast", minval = 0.1, maxval = 3.0, step = 0.05, group = gP)
volLen     = input.int(20, "Volume baseline length", minval = 1, group = gP)
useBinance = input.bool(true,  "BTC: aggregate Binance volume",  group = gP, tooltip = "On BTC pairs the three venues' volume is aggregated for a fuller pressure read. Every other market uses its own chart volume automatically.")
useCoinbase= input.bool(true,  "BTC: aggregate Coinbase volume", group = gP)
useBitstamp= input.bool(true,  "BTC: aggregate Bitstamp volume", group = gP)

gR = "03 · Session Ranges (timed range context)"
useRange   = input.bool(true, "Enable session ranges", group = gR, tooltip = "Intraday charts only — on Daily and above this module switches itself off and the Range pillar reads neutral.")
tzInput    = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone", options = ["Exchange", "UTC", "America/New_York", "America/Chicago", "Europe/London", "Europe/Berlin", "Asia/Karachi", "Asia/Kolkata", "Asia/Dubai", "Asia/Tokyo", "Asia/Singapore", "Australia/Sydney"], group = gR)
w1On       = input.bool(true, "Window 1", group = gR, inline = "w1")
w1Name     = input.string("NY", "Name", group = gR, inline = "w1")
w1Range    = input.session("0930-0945", "Range", group = gR, inline = "w1s")
w1Full     = input.session("0930-1600", "Session", group = gR, inline = "w1s")
w2On       = input.bool(true, "Window 2", group = gR, inline = "w2")
w2Name     = input.string("LON", "Name", group = gR, inline = "w2")
w2Range    = input.session("0300-0315", "Range", group = gR, inline = "w2s")
w2Full     = input.session("0300-1100", "Session", group = gR, inline = "w2s")
w3On       = input.bool(false, "Window 3", group = gR, inline = "w3")
w3Name     = input.string("ASIA", "Name", group = gR, inline = "w3")
w3Range    = input.session("2000-2015", "Range", group = gR, inline = "w3s")
w3Full     = input.session("2000-0400", "Session", group = gR, inline = "w3s")
rangeSat   = input.float(1.0, "Range pillar saturates at (x range beyond Cap / Floor)", minval = 0.25, maxval = 5.0, step = 0.25, group = gR, tooltip = "A burst this many range-widths beyond the Pressure Cap (range high) or Pressure Floor (range low) scores a full Range pillar (STRB T2 by default).")
showRangeBox = input.bool(true, "Draw range box + Cap / Floor / Equilibrium", group = gR, tooltip = "Pressure Cap = range high, Pressure Floor = range low, Equilibrium = midpoint. Each level carries a window-prefixed name tag on the chart.")
showRangeTags = input.bool(true, "Show level name tags", group = gR)
keepDays   = input.int(4, "Ranges kept on chart (per window)", minval = 1, maxval = 20, group = gR)
w1Col      = input.color(#2962FF, "W1", group = gR, inline = "wc")
w2Col      = input.color(#AB47BC, "W2", group = gR, inline = "wc")
w3Col      = input.color(#00ACC1, "W3", group = gR, inline = "wc")

gF = "04 · Signal Filter & Pressure Gates"
fadeMin    = input.int(3, "Min stack height to signal", minval = 1, maxval = 6, group = gF)
minMag     = input.float(0.0, "Min burst magnitude (ATR beyond band)", minval = 0, maxval = 12, step = 0.1, group = gF)
needRej    = input.bool(false, "Require rejection wick on the peak bar", group = gF)
rejMin     = input.float(0.30, "Min rejection wick (share of peak-bar range)", minval = 0, maxval = 0.95, step = 0.05, group = gF)
useRsiGate = input.bool(false, "Require RSI exhaustion", group = gF)
rsiLen     = input.int(14, "RSI length", minval = 2, maxval = 100, group = gF)
rsiOB      = input.float(65, "RSI overbought (SHORT above)", minval = 51, maxval = 99, group = gF)
rsiOS      = input.float(35, "RSI oversold (LONG below)", minval = 1, maxval = 49, group = gF)
needCluster= input.bool(false, "GATE · burst must hit / sweep an opposing cluster", group = gF, tooltip = "A SHORT needs the up-burst to reach into a short-liquidation cluster above; a LONG needs the down-burst to reach into a long-liquidation cluster below. A reclaim on the signal bar also satisfies it.")
clProx     = input.float(1.0, "Cluster proximity for partial credit (ATR)", minval = 0.1, maxval = 10, step = 0.1, group = gF, tooltip = "If the burst stops short of a cluster, the Pressure pillar still earns partial credit when the cluster is within this many ATR of the peak extreme.")
needRange  = input.bool(false, "GATE · burst must extend beyond the session range", group = gF)
sessionOnly= input.bool(false, "GATE · only trade inside an enabled trading session", group = gF)
allowShort = input.bool(true, "Allow SHORTS (up bursts)", group = gF)
allowLong  = input.bool(true, "Allow LONGS (down bursts)", group = gF)
cooldown   = input.int(20, "Minimum spacing between signals (bars)", minval = 0, maxval = 500, group = gF)

gT = "05 · Trade Levels & Universal Zones"
stopMode   = input.string("Burst Extreme", "Stop basis", options = ["Burst Extreme", "ATR Multiple", "Swing Extreme"], group = gT)
swingLook  = input.int(10, "Swing lookback (bars)", minval = 2, maxval = 200, group = gT)
stopAtr    = input.float(1.2, "Stop distance (ATR)", minval = 0.1, maxval = 10, step = 0.1, group = gT)
slBuf      = input.float(0.30, "Stop buffer beyond extreme (ATR)", minval = 0.0, maxval = 3, step = 0.05, group = gT)
maxRisk    = input.float(3.0, "Max risk (ATR) — stop cap", minval = 0.3, maxval = 10, step = 0.1, group = gT)
minRisk    = input.float(0.5, "Min risk (ATR) — stop floor", minval = 0.1, maxval = 5, step = 0.1, group = gT)
targetMode = input.string("Pressure Ladder", "Target ladder", options = ["R Multiples", "Mean Reversion (band → basis)", "Pressure Ladder"], group = gT, tooltip = "Pressure Ladder: TP1/2/3 snap to the nearest opposing liquidation clusters in the trade direction (price magnets); any missing rung falls back to its R multiple.\nMean Reversion: TP1 halfway to the basis, TP2 at the basis, TP3 half a band beyond.")
ladderMinR = input.float(0.6, "Pressure Ladder · min rung distance (R)", minval = 0.1, maxval = 5, step = 0.1, group = gT)
tp1R       = input.float(1.0, "TP1 (R)", minval = 0.25, maxval = 50, step = 0.25, group = gT)
tp2R       = input.float(2.0, "TP2 (R)", minval = 0.25, maxval = 50, step = 0.25, group = gT)
tp3R       = input.float(3.0, "TP3 (R)", minval = 0.25, maxval = 50, step = 0.25, group = gT)
maxHunt    = input.int(200, "Max bars in trade (time stop)", minval = 5, maxval = 5000, group = gT)
zoneW      = input.int(18, "UNIVERSAL zone width (bars)", minval = 3, maxval = 150, group = gT)
showBoxes  = input.bool(true, "Show SL / TP zones", group = gT)
showLines  = input.bool(true, "Show SL / TP lines", group = gT)
showLevelLbl = input.bool(true, "Label level prices", group = gT)
showExitLbl  = input.bool(true, "Show trade result labels", group = gT)
showBasisMark= input.bool(true, "Show basis marker on entry", group = gT)
maxHist    = input.int(16, "Max historical tickets drawn", minval = 1, maxval = 30, group = gT, tooltip = "Visual cap only. Statistics stay cumulative over every closed trade.")

gS = "06 · Strength Ranking (0-10)"
minStars   = input.int(0, "Minimum stars to take", minval = 0, maxval = 4, group = gS)
alertStars = input.int(0, "Alert minimum stars", minval = 0, maxval = 4, group = gS)
wExt   = input.float(0.16, "Weight · Burst Extension",     minval = 0, maxval = 1, step = 0.01, group = gS)
wStack = input.float(0.12, "Weight · Stack Height",        minval = 0, maxval = 1, step = 0.01, group = gS)
wExh   = input.float(0.12, "Weight · Momentum Exhaustion", minval = 0, maxval = 1, step = 0.01, group = gS)
wRej   = input.float(0.10, "Weight · Rejection Wick",      minval = 0, maxval = 1, step = 0.01, group = gS)
wTrend = input.float(0.08, "Weight · Trend Fit",           minval = 0, maxval = 1, step = 0.01, group = gS)
wCalm  = input.float(0.06, "Weight · Volatility Regime",   minval = 0, maxval = 1, step = 0.01, group = gS)
wRoom  = input.float(0.06, "Weight · Reversion Room",      minval = 0, maxval = 1, step = 0.01, group = gS)
wPress = input.float(0.20, "Weight · PRESSURE Cluster",    minval = 0, maxval = 1, step = 0.01, group = gS, tooltip = "Peak into / sweep of an opposing liquidation cluster, weighted by that cluster's 0-10 strength. A reclaim on the signal bar scores 0.9.")
wRange = input.float(0.10, "Weight · Session RANGE",       minval = 0, maxval = 1, step = 0.01, group = gS, tooltip = "Burst over-extension beyond the timed session range. A failed breakout back inside on the signal bar scores 0.9. Neutral (0.5) when no range is live.")

gD = "07 · Dashboard"
showDash    = input.bool(true, "Show dashboard", group = gD)
dashPosOpt  = input.string("Top Right", "Position", options = ["Top Right", "Top Left", "Bottom Right", "Bottom Left", "Middle Right", "Middle Left"], group = gD)
dashSizeOpt = input.string("Small", "Text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal"], group = gD)
gaugeLen    = input.int(10, "Gauge width (blocks)", minval = 4, maxval = 20, group = gD)
showGauges  = input.bool(true, "Show live quality sliders", group = gD)
showPressRows = input.bool(true, "Show pressure context", group = gD)
showRangeRows = input.bool(true, "Show session range context", group = gD)
showHeatRow = input.bool(true, "Show TP1/2/3 · SL breakdown", group = gD)
showTiers   = input.bool(true, "Show win rate by strength", group = gD)
showRecent  = input.bool(true, "Show last trades", group = gD)
showMtf     = input.bool(true, "Show MTF burst strip", group = gD)
mtfTf2      = input.timeframe("15", "MTF · TF 2", group = gD)
mtfTf3      = input.timeframe("60", "MTF · TF 3", group = gD)

gV = "08 · Visuals & Theme"
theme      = input.string("Aurora", "Color theme", options = ["Aurora", "Gold Noir", "Bloomberg Amber", "Ice Blue", "Aqua Violet", "Neon Magenta", "Institutional"], group = gV)
showSignal = input.bool(true, "Show signal labels", group = gV)
showStars  = input.bool(true, "Show ★ ranking on labels", group = gV)
lblSizeOpt = input.string("Small", "Signal label size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = gV)
showBg     = input.bool(false, "Tint background on extreme bursts", group = gV)
showReclaimMarks = input.bool(false, "Show cluster reclaim diamonds", group = gV, tooltip = "Diamonds mark a sweep-and-reclaim of a cluster (support tone below, resistance tone above). Off by default to keep the chart clean — the reclaim still feeds the Pressure pillar, the dashboard event log and the alerts.")
showFailMarks    = input.bool(true, "Show failed range-breakout crosses", group = gV)
showBubbles= input.bool(true, "Show cluster bubbles", group = gV)
showGlow   = input.bool(true, "Bubble glow halo", group = gV)
showScore  = input.bool(true, "Show strength inside bubble", group = gV)
bubbleBoost= input.int(1, "Bubble size boost", minval = 0, maxval = 2, group = gV)
showLevels = input.bool(true, "Show cluster level lines", group = gV)
levelWidth = input.int(5, "Cluster level width", minval = 1, maxval = 10, group = gV)
levelTransp= input.int(70, "Cluster level transparency", minval = 0, maxval = 100, group = gV)
levelProj  = input.int(3, "Project levels past current bar", minval = 0, maxval = 200, group = gV)
colorMode  = input.string("By Side", "Cluster color mode", options = ["Spectrum (vertical)", "By Side"], group = gV)
topCol     = input.color(#21c997, "Top / Support tone",    group = gV, inline = "cc")
midCol     = input.color(#5b6cff, "Mid",                   group = gV, inline = "cc")
botCol     = input.color(#cc24e2, "Bottom / Resist tone",  group = gV, inline = "cc")
cCold      = input.color(#26c6da, "Mild",    group = gV, inline = "heat")
cWarm      = input.color(#ffd54a, "Warm",    group = gV, inline = "heat")
cHot       = input.color(#ff7a1a, "Hot",     group = gV, inline = "heat")
cExtreme   = input.color(#ff2b4e, "Extreme", group = gV, inline = "heat")

longCol  = theme == "Gold Noir" ? color.rgb(230, 184, 75) : theme == "Bloomberg Amber" ? color.rgb(255, 176, 46) : theme == "Ice Blue" ? color.rgb(38, 198, 255) : theme == "Aqua Violet" ? color.rgb(0, 225, 200) : theme == "Neon Magenta" ? color.rgb(0, 230, 200) : theme == "Institutional" ? color.rgb(31, 176, 118) : color.rgb(20, 214, 122)
shortCol = theme == "Gold Noir" ? color.rgb(203, 68, 56) : theme == "Bloomberg Amber" ? color.rgb(233, 84, 72) : theme == "Ice Blue" ? color.rgb(255, 112, 92) : theme == "Aqua Violet" ? color.rgb(184, 122, 255) : theme == "Neon Magenta" ? color.rgb(255, 62, 190) : theme == "Institutional" ? color.rgb(176, 62, 74) : color.rgb(243, 62, 110)
tpFill   = theme == "Gold Noir" ? color.rgb(120, 92, 20) : theme == "Bloomberg Amber" ? color.rgb(126, 86, 14) : theme == "Ice Blue" ? color.rgb(0, 92, 132) : theme == "Aqua Violet" ? color.rgb(0, 96, 88) : theme == "Neon Magenta" ? color.rgb(0, 98, 86) : theme == "Institutional" ? color.rgb(18, 96, 66) : color.rgb(12, 104, 64)
slFill   = theme == "Gold Noir" ? color.rgb(120, 40, 30) : theme == "Bloomberg Amber" ? color.rgb(122, 44, 34) : theme == "Ice Blue" ? color.rgb(140, 44, 66) : theme == "Aqua Violet" ? color.rgb(96, 40, 120) : theme == "Neon Magenta" ? color.rgb(128, 26, 90) : theme == "Institutional" ? color.rgb(110, 34, 42) : color.rgb(140, 30, 62)

color panelBg     = #0a0c12
color panelBgAlt  = #0f131c
color panelHdr    = #161b27
color panelBorder = #2c3342
color txtHi       = #ebeef5
color txtLo       = #8791a2
color neutralCol  = #69748a
color goodCol     = #21c87a
color badCol      = #e6435a
color warnCol     = color.rgb(214, 176, 74)
color midGray     = #9598A1

f_clamp(float v) => math.min(math.max(v, 0.0), 1.0)

f_size(string s) =>
    switch s
        "Tiny"   => size.tiny
        "Small"  => size.small
        "Normal" => size.normal
        "Large"  => size.large
        => size.small

f_pos(string p) =>
    switch p
        "Top Left"     => position.top_left
        "Top Right"    => position.top_right
        "Bottom Left"  => position.bottom_left
        "Bottom Right" => position.bottom_right
        "Middle Right" => position.middle_right
        "Middle Left"  => position.middle_left
        => position.top_right

f_stars(float sc) => sc >= 7.5 ? "★★★★" : sc >= 6.5 ? "★★★" : sc >= 5.5 ? "★★" : sc >= 4.5 ? "★" : "·"
f_tier(float sc)  => sc >= 7.5 ? 4 : sc >= 6.5 ? 3 : sc >= 5.5 ? 2 : sc >= 4.5 ? 1 : 0
f_tname(float sc) => sc >= 7.5 ? "ELITE" : sc >= 6.5 ? "STRONG" : sc >= 5.5 ? "MODERATE" : sc >= 4.5 ? "WEAK" : "MINIMAL"
f_signedR(float v) => (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(v, "#.##") + "R"
f_px(float v) => na(v) ? "—" : str.tostring(v, format.mintick)

f_gauge(float v01, int n) =>
    int filled = math.max(0, math.min(n, int(math.round(f_clamp(v01) * n))))
    string s = ""
    for i = 1 to n
        s := s + (i <= filled ? "█" : "░")
    s

f_gcol(float v01) =>
    float t = f_clamp(v01)
    t < 0.5 ? color.from_gradient(t, 0.0, 0.5, badCol, warnCol) : color.from_gradient(t, 0.5, 1.0, warnCol, goodCol)

f_heat(float t) =>
    float tt = f_clamp(t)
    tt < 0.40 ? color.from_gradient(tt, 0.0, 0.40, cCold, cWarm) : tt < 0.75 ? color.from_gradient(tt, 0.40, 0.75, cWarm, cHot) : color.from_gradient(tt, 0.75, 1.0, cHot, cExtreme)

f_spectrum(float t) =>
    float x = f_clamp(t)
    x < 0.5 ? color.from_gradient(x / 0.5, 0.0, 1.0, botCol, midCol) : color.from_gradient((x - 0.5) / 0.5, 0.0, 1.0, midCol, topCol)

basis = switch basisType
    "SMA"  => ta.sma(srcIn, basisLen)
    "HMA"  => ta.hma(srcIn, basisLen)
    "WMA"  => ta.wma(srcIn, basisLen)
    "VWMA" => ta.vwma(srcIn, basisLen)
    "RMA"  => ta.rma(srcIn, basisLen)
    => ta.ema(srcIn, basisLen)

atr        = ta.atr(atrLen)
rsi        = ta.rsi(close, rsiLen)
atrPct     = ta.percentrank(atr, 100)
basisSlope = ta.change(basis, 3)
swingLo    = ta.lowest(low, swingLook)
swingHi    = ta.highest(high, swingLook)

float aSafe = nz(atr) > 0 ? atr : syminfo.mintick
float bSafe = nz(basis, close)
float upper = basis + bandMult * atr
float lower = basis - bandMult * atr

float upExtP = high - upper
float dnExtP = lower - low
float upMag  = na(upExtP) ? 0.0 : upExtP / aSafe
float dnMag  = na(dnExtP) ? 0.0 : dnExtP / aSafe

bool upSpike = not na(upper) and upExtP > 0 and (not needClose or close > upper)
bool dnSpike = not na(lower) and dnExtP > 0 and (not needClose or close < lower)
bool okBar   = confirmBar ? barstate.isconfirmed : true

float upM0 = upSpike ? math.max(0.0, upMag) : 0.0
float dnM0 = dnSpike ? math.max(0.0, dnMag) : 0.0

bool upPeak = okBar and nz(upM0[1]) > 0 and nz(upM0[1]) >= nz(upM0[2]) and nz(upM0[1]) > upM0
bool dnPeak = okBar and nz(dnM0[1]) > 0 and nz(dnM0[1]) >= nz(dnM0[2]) and nz(dnM0[1]) > dnM0

float upPk = nz(upM0[1])
float dnPk = nz(dnM0[1])
int   upLvlPk = math.min(maxLevels, 1 + int(upPk / stepATR))
int   dnLvlPk = math.min(maxLevels, 1 + int(dnPk / stepATR))

float pkHi    = nz(high[1], high)
float pkLo    = nz(low[1], low)
float pkOpen  = nz(open[1], open)
float pkClose = nz(close[1], close)
float pkRange = math.max(pkHi - pkLo, syminfo.mintick)
float upRej   = (pkHi - math.max(pkOpen, pkClose)) / pkRange
float dnRej   = (math.min(pkOpen, pkClose) - pkLo) / pkRange
float rsiPk   = nz(rsi[1], 50.0)

int   liveDir = upSpike ? -1 : dnSpike ? 1 : (close > bSafe ? -1 : 1)
float liveMag = upSpike ? upMag : dnSpike ? dnMag : 0.0
int   liveLvl = upSpike or dnSpike ? math.min(maxLevels, 1 + int(math.max(0.0, liveMag) / stepATR)) : 0
float barRng  = math.max(high - low, syminfo.mintick)
float liveRej = liveDir == -1 ? (high - math.max(open, close)) / barRng : (math.min(open, close) - low) / barRng

int   n      = bar_index
float atrRaw = math.max(nz(ta.atr(clAtrLen), ta.cum(high - low) / (n + 1)), syminfo.mintick)

bool  isBTC = syminfo.basecurrency == "BTC"
float binV  = useBinance  and isBTC ? request.security("BINANCE:BTCUSD",  timeframe.period, volume, gaps = barmerge.gaps_off) : 0.0
float cbV   = useCoinbase and isBTC ? request.security("COINBASE:BTCUSD", timeframe.period, volume, gaps = barmerge.gaps_off) : 0.0
float bsV   = useBitstamp and isBTC ? request.security("BITSTAMP:BTCUSD", timeframe.period, volume, gaps = barmerge.gaps_off) : 0.0
float cumV   = binV + cbV + bsV
float volVal = cumV > 0 ? cumV : volume
float volBase= ta.sma(volVal, volLen)

float liqWeight = volVal * (high - low) * 100.0
float weightMax = math.min(ta.highest(liqWeight, weightLB), 1e10)
float weightMinR= ta.lowest(liqWeight, weightLB)
float weightMin = weightMinR == weightMax ? weightMax * 0.85 : weightMinR
float specHi    = ta.highest(high, weightLB)

f_zoneCol(float mid, int side) =>
    color c = na
    if colorMode == "By Side"
        c := side == 1 ? topCol : botCol
    else
        float vr = specHi - specLo
        float nv = vr > 0 ? f_clamp((mid - specLo) / vr) : 0.5
        c := f_spectrum(nv)
    c

f_wnorm(float w) =>
    float den = weightMax - weightMin
    float nw  = den > 0 ? f_clamp((w - weightMin) / den) : 0.5
    math.pow(nw, magContrast)

f_tierOf(float wn) => wn < 0.25 ? 0 : wn < 0.5 ? 1 : wn < 0.75 ? 2 : 3
f_coreSize(int t)  => t <= 0 ? size.small : t == 1 ? size.normal : t == 2 ? size.large : size.huge
f_glowSize(int t)  => f_coreSize(t + 1)
f_rangeOverlap(float t1, float b1, float t2, float b2) =>
    float ov   = math.min(t1, t2) - math.max(b1, b2)
    float minH = math.min(t1 - b1, t2 - b2)
    ov > 0 and minH > 0 and ov / minH >= overlapThr / 100.0

f_defense(zone z) =>

    float vF = volBase > 0 and z.volN > 0 ? math.min((z.volSum / z.volN) / volBase, 1.0) : 0.0
    float wF = z.wickN > 0 ? math.min((z.wickSum / z.wickN) / atrRaw, 1.0) : 0.0
    float sF = math.min(z.sweeps / 2.0, 1.0)
    tF * 0.30 + vF * 0.20 + wF * 0.20 + sF * 0.30

f_ageF(int age) => math.max(1.0 - 0.35 * math.min(age / 400.0, 1.0), 0.65)

method buildBubble(zone self) =>

    if not na(self.core)

    if not na(self.num)
        label.delete(self.num)
    self.glow := na
    self.core := na
    self.num  := na
    if showBubbles
        color base = f_zoneCol(self.mid, self.dir)
        int   t    = math.min(self.tier + bubbleBoost, 3)
        if showGlow
            self.glow := label.new(self.bornBar, self.mid, "", xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_circle, color = color.new(base, 88), size = f_glowSize(t))
        self.core := label.new(self.bornBar, self.mid, "", xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_circle, color = color.new(base, 66), size = f_coreSize(t))
        if showScore
            self.num := label.new(self.bornBar, self.mid, "", xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_center, color = color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor = color.white, size = size.small)

    color base = f_zoneCol(self.mid, self.dir)
    int   ct   = int(math.round(66.0 - 46.0 * f_clamp(sc / 10.0)))
    if showLevels
        int lx2 = n + levelProj

        if not na(self.ln)
            line.set_color(self.ln, color.new(base, self.phase == 1 ? math.min(levelTransp + 15, 100) : levelTransp))
    else if not na(self.ln)
        line.delete(self.ln)
        self.ln := na
    int et = math.min(self.tier + bubbleBoost, 3)
    if not na(self.core)
        label.set_color(self.core, color.new(base, ct))
        label.set_size(self.core, f_coreSize(et))
    if not na(self.glow)
        label.set_color(self.glow, color.new(base, math.min(ct + 22, 100)))
        label.set_size(self.glow, f_glowSize(et))

f_overlapsActive(float t, float b) =>
    bool hit = false
    if array.size(zones) > 0
        for z in zones
            if not z.dead and z.phase != 1 and f_rangeOverlap(t, b, z.top, z.bot)
                hit := true
                break
    hit

        z.volSum  := nz(volVal)
        z.volN    := 1

        z.tier    := f_tierOf(wn)
        z.buildBubble()
        array.push(zones, z)

f_runWin(Win w, bool enabled, bool inR, bool inF) =>
    bool brkUp = false
    bool brkDn = false
    bool failU = false
    bool failD = false
    bool rDone = false
    if enabled and barstate.isconfirmed
        bool rStart = inR and not w.wasInside
        bool rEnd   = not inR and w.wasInside
        if not inF and w.wasFull
            w.armed := false
        if rStart
            w.hi        := high
            w.lo        := low
            w.startBar  := bar_index
            w.done      := false
            w.armed     := false
            w.extending := false
            w.brk       := 0
            w.failed    := false
            w.sessions  += 1
            if showRangeBox
                while array.size(w.bxs) >= keepDays
                    box.delete(array.shift(w.bxs))
                while array.size(w.lns) > (keepDays - 1) * 3
                    line.delete(array.shift(w.lns))
                while array.size(w.lbls) > (keepDays - 1) * 3
                    label.delete(array.shift(w.lbls))
                array.push(w.bxs, box.new(bar_index, high, bar_index, low, bgcolor = color.new(w.col, 88), border_color = w.col, border_width = 1))
        else if inR and not na(w.hi)
            w.hi := math.max(w.hi, high)
            w.lo := math.min(w.lo, low)
        if inR and showRangeBox and array.size(w.bxs) > 0
            box bx = array.get(w.bxs, array.size(w.bxs) - 1)
            box.set_top(bx, w.hi)
            box.set_bottom(bx, w.lo)
            box.set_right(bx, bar_index)
        if rEnd and not na(w.hi) and not w.done
            w.done  := true
            w.armed := true
            rDone   := true
            if showRangeBox
                array.push(w.lns, line.new(w.startBar, w.hi, bar_index, w.hi, color = longCol,  width = 2))
                array.push(w.lns, line.new(w.startBar, w.lo, bar_index, w.lo, color = shortCol, width = 2))
                array.push(w.lns, line.new(w.startBar, (w.hi + w.lo) / 2, bar_index, (w.hi + w.lo) / 2, color = color.new(midGray, 30), width = 1, style = line.style_dashed))
                if showRangeTags
                    array.push(w.lbls, label.new(bar_index, w.hi, w.name + " Pressure Cap", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(longCol, 100), textcolor = longCol, size = size.small))
                    array.push(w.lbls, label.new(bar_index, w.lo, w.name + " Pressure Floor", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(shortCol, 100), textcolor = shortCol, size = size.small))
                    array.push(w.lbls, label.new(bar_index, (w.hi + w.lo) / 2, w.name + " Equilibrium", style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(midGray, 100), textcolor = midGray, size = size.small))
            w.extending := inF
        if w.extending and not inF
            w.extending := false
        if w.extending and array.size(w.lns) >= 3
            int sz = array.size(w.lns)
            for i = sz - 3 to sz - 1
                line.set_x2(array.get(w.lns, i), bar_index)
        if w.extending and array.size(w.lbls) >= 3
            int lz = array.size(w.lbls)
            for i = lz - 3 to lz - 1
                label.set_x(array.get(w.lbls, i), bar_index)
        if w.armed and w.done and inF and not inR and not na(w.hi)
            if w.brk == 0
                if close > w.hi
                    brkUp := true
                    w.brk := 1
                    w.nBrk += 1
                else if close < w.lo
                    brkDn := true
                    w.brk := -1
                    w.nBrk += 1
            else if not w.failed
                if w.brk == 1 and close < w.hi
                    failU    := true
                    w.failed := true
                    w.nFail  += 1
                else if w.brk == -1 and close > w.lo
                    failD    := true
                    w.failed := true
                    w.nFail  += 1
        w.wasInside := inR
        w.wasFull   := inF
    [brkUp, brkDn, failU, failD, rDone]

f_pressN(int dir, bool hitNow, float hitSc, bool hitPrev, float hitScPrev, float ext, float nearPx, float nearSc, bool reclaimed) =>

            v := (1.0 - d / clProx) * math.max(nz(nearSc), 1.0) / 10.0 * 0.7

        v := math.max(v, 0.9)
    f_clamp(v)

f_score(int dir, float mag, int lvl, float rsiVal, float rejRaw, float entry, float pressN, float rangeN) =>
    float extN   = f_clamp(mag / math.max(heatSat, 0.1))
    float stackN = f_clamp(lvl * 1.0 / math.max(maxLevels, 1))
    float exhN   = dir == 1 ? f_clamp((50.0 - rsiVal) / 30.0) : f_clamp((rsiVal - 50.0) / 30.0)
    float rejN   = f_clamp(rejRaw / 0.6)
    float slopeN = nz(basisSlope) / aSafe
    float trendN = f_clamp((dir * slopeN + 1.0) / 2.0)
    float calmN  = f_clamp(1.0 - nz(atrPct, 50.0) / 100.0)
    float roomN  = f_clamp(math.abs(entry - bSafe) / (math.max(bandMult, 0.1) * aSafe * 1.5))
    float wsum   = wExt + wStack + wExh + wRej + wTrend + wCalm + wRoom + wPress + wRange
    float raw    = wsum > 0 ? (extN * wExt + stackN * wStack + exhN * wExh + rejN * wRej + trendN * wTrend + calmN * wCalm + roomN * wRoom + pressN * wPress + rangeN * wRange) / wsum : 0.0
    [extN, stackN, exhN, rejN, trendN, calmN, roomN, pressN, rangeN, math.min(math.max(raw * 10.0, 0.0), 10.0)]

    string tt = "Setup quality: " + str.tostring(math.round(sc * 10) / 10) + "/10  " + f_stars(sc) + "  " + f_tname(sc)
    tt += "\nDirection: " + (dir == 1 ? "LONG (down burst)" : "SHORT (up burst)")
    tt += "\nBurst magnitude: " + str.tostring(mag, "#.##") + " ATR beyond band"
    tt += "\nStack height: " + str.tostring(lvl) + "/" + str.tostring(maxLevels)
    tt += "\nExhaustion (RSI): " + str.tostring(rsiPk, "#.#")
    tt += "\nRejection wick: " + str.tostring((dir == 1 ? dnRej : upRej) * 100, "#") + "% of peak bar"
    tt += "\nPressure cluster: " + str.tostring(prsN * 100, "#") + "%" + (dir == 1 ? (clusterDn ? "  (hit / swept)" : "") : (clusterUp ? "  (hit / swept)" : ""))

    tt += "\nVolatility pctile: " + str.tostring(nz(atrPct), "#") + "  (calmer = better)"
    tt += "\nNote: a confluence read, not a win-rate guarantee."
    tt

f_logRecent(string s, float r) =>
    array.unshift(recentOut, s)
    array.unshift(recentR, r)
    if array.size(recentOut) > 10
        array.pop(recentOut)
    if array.size(recentR) > 10
        array.pop(recentR)

bool closedTp3 = false
bool closedSl  = false
bool closedTp  = false
bool closedExp = false

if tradeActive
    bool tp1Hit = tradeSide == 1 ? high >= tTp1 : low <= tTp1
    bool tp2Hit = tradeSide == 1 ? high >= tTp2 : low <= tTp2
    bool tp3Hit = tradeSide == 1 ? high >= tTp3 : low <= tTp3
    bool slHit  = tradeSide == 1 ? low <= tStop : high >= tStop

    int  stage     = tp3Hit ? 3 : tp2Hit ? 2 : tp1Hit ? 1 : 0
    bool sameBarSl = slHit and stage > 0
    if stage > bestStage and not sameBarSl
        bestStage := stage

    int  barsIn    = not na(tradeBar) ? bar_index - tradeBar : 0
    bool finalTp3  = not sameBarSl and bestStage == 3
    bool finalSl   = slHit and (bestStage == 0 or sameBarSl)
    bool finalTp   = slHit and not sameBarSl and bestStage > 0 and bestStage < 3
    bool expireNow = not finalTp3 and not finalSl and not finalTp and barsIn >= maxHunt

    if finalTp3 or finalSl or finalTp or expireNow
        float mtmR = math.abs(tEntry - tStop) > 0 ? (tradeSide == 1 ? (close - tEntry) : (tEntry - close)) / math.abs(tEntry - tStop) : 0.0
        float resR = finalTp3 ? tR3 : finalTp and bestStage == 2 ? tR2 : finalTp and bestStage == 1 ? tR1 : expireNow ? mtmR : -1.0

        closedTp3 := finalTp3
        closedSl  := finalSl
        closedTp  := finalTp
        closedExp := expireNow

        bool isWin = resR > 0
        sClosed += 1
        sR      += resR
        if isWin
            sWins     += 1
            sGrossWin += resR
            sCurWin   += 1
            sCurLos   := 0
            sMaxWin   := math.max(sMaxWin, sCurWin)
            sStreak   := sCurWin
            array.set(tierWin, tradeTier, array.get(tierWin, tradeTier) + 1)
        else
            sGrossLos += math.abs(resR)
            sCurLos   += 1
            sCurWin   := 0
            sMaxLos   := math.max(sMaxLos, sCurLos)
            sStreak   := -sCurLos
            array.set(tierLoss, tradeTier, array.get(tierLoss, tradeTier) + 1)
        if tradeSide == 1
            sLong    += 1
            sLongWin += isWin ? 1 : 0
        else
            sShort    += 1
            sShortWin += isWin ? 1 : 0
        if tradePress
            sPress    += 1
            sPressWin += isWin ? 1 : 0
        if tradeRange
            sRange    += 1
            sRangeWin += isWin ? 1 : 0
        if finalTp3
            sTp3 += 1
            f_logRecent("TP3", resR)
        else if finalTp and bestStage == 2
            sTp2 += 1
            f_logRecent("TP2", resR)
        else if finalTp and bestStage == 1
            sTp1 += 1
            f_logRecent("TP1", resR)
        else if expireNow
            sExp += 1
            f_logRecent("TIME", resR)
        else
            sSl += 1
            f_logRecent("SL", resR)

        float resPrice = finalTp3 ? tTp3 : finalTp and bestStage == 2 ? tTp2 : finalTp and bestStage == 1 ? tTp1 : expireNow ? close : tStop
        string resTxt  = finalTp3 ? "TP3 ✔ " + f_signedR(resR) : finalTp ? "TP" + str.tostring(bestStage) + " ✔ " + f_signedR(resR) : expireNow ? (isWin ? "TIME ✔ " : "TIME ✘ ") + f_signedR(resR) : "SL ✘ " + f_signedR(resR)
        color resCol   = resR >= 0 ? longCol : shortCol
        string resStyle = tradeSide == 1 ? (resR >= 0 ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up) : (resR >= 0 ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down)

        if showExitLbl
            aExit := label.new(bar_index, resPrice, resTxt, style = resStyle, color = color.new(resCol, 0), textcolor = color.white, size = size.small)

        tradeViz tv = tradeViz.new(aEntry, aSl, aT1, aT2, aT3, aBm, aB1, aB2, aB3, aSlBox, aSig, aLEntry, aLSl, aLT1, aLT2, aLT3, aExit)
        array.push(history, tv)
        while array.size(history) > maxHist
            tradeViz old = array.shift(history)
            line.delete(old.e)
            line.delete(old.s)
            line.delete(old.t1)
            line.delete(old.t2)
            line.delete(old.t3)
            line.delete(old.bm)
            box.delete(old.b1)
            box.delete(old.b2)
            box.delete(old.b3)
            box.delete(old.sb)
            label.delete(old.sg)
            label.delete(old.le)
            label.delete(old.ls)
            label.delete(old.l1)
            label.delete(old.l2)
            label.delete(old.l3)
            label.delete(old.ex)

        aEntry  := na
        aSl     := na
        aT1     := na
        aT2     := na
        aT3     := na
        aBm     := na
        aB1     := na
        aB2     := na
        aB3     := na
        aSlBox  := na

        tradeSide   := 0

        tTp3        := na

    bool  isLong  = fireDir == 1
    float entv    = close

    float burstLo = math.min(low, pkLo)
    float rawStop = stopMode == "ATR Multiple" ? (isLong ? entv - atr * stopAtr : entv + atr * stopAtr) : stopMode == "Swing Extreme" ? (isLong ? swingLo - atr * slBuf : swingHi + atr * slBuf) : (isLong ? burstLo - atr * slBuf : burstHi + atr * slBuf)
    float risk0   = math.abs(entv - rawStop)
    float risk    = math.min(math.max(risk0, atr * minRisk), atr * maxRisk)
    float stopv   = isLong ? entv - risk : entv + risk

    float r1 = isLong ? entv + risk * tp1R : entv - risk * tp1R
    float r2 = isLong ? entv + risk * tp2R : entv - risk * tp2R
    float r3 = isLong ? entv + risk * tp3R : entv - risk * tp3R

    bool  revOk = targetMode == "Mean Reversion (band → basis)" and (isLong ? bSafe > entv : bSafe < entv)
    float half  = math.abs(bSafe - entv) * 0.5
    float band  = math.max(bandMult, 0.1) * aSafe * 0.5

    float l1 = na
    float l2 = na
    float l3 = na
    if targetMode == "Pressure Ladder" and array.size(zones) > 0
        array<float> cands = array.new<float>()
        for z in zones
            if not z.dead and z.dir == (isLong ? -1 : 1)
                float d = isLong ? z.mid - entv : entv - z.mid
                if d >= risk * ladderMinR
                    array.push(cands, d)
        array.sort(cands, order.ascending)
        int nc = array.size(cands)
        if nc >= 1
            l1 := isLong ? entv + array.get(cands, 0) : entv - array.get(cands, 0)
        if nc >= 2
            l2 := isLong ? entv + array.get(cands, 1) : entv - array.get(cands, 1)
        if nc >= 3
            l3 := isLong ? entv + array.get(cands, 2) : entv - array.get(cands, 2)
    float t1 = revOk ? (isLong ? entv + half : entv - half) : not na(l1) ? l1 : r1
    float t2 = revOk ? bSafe : not na(l2) ? l2 : (isLong ? math.max(r2, t1 + risk * 0.5) : math.min(r2, t1 - risk * 0.5))
    float t3 = revOk ? (isLong ? bSafe + band : bSafe - band) : not na(l3) ? l3 : (isLong ? math.max(r3, t2 + risk * 0.5) : math.min(r3, t2 - risk * 0.5))

    tradeActive := true
    tradeSide   := isLong ? 1 : -1
    tradeBar    := bar_index
    tEntry      := entv
    tStop       := stopv
    tTp1        := t1
    tTp2        := t2
    tTp3        := t3
    tR1         := risk > 0 ? math.abs(t1 - entv) / risk : 0.0
    tR2         := risk > 0 ? math.abs(t2 - entv) / risk : 0.0
    tR3         := risk > 0 ? math.abs(t3 - entv) / risk : 0.0
    bestStage   := 0
    tradeScore  := sgScore
    tradeTier   := f_tier(sgScore)
    tradePress  := isLong ? clusterDn : clusterUp
    tradeRange  := isLong ? beyondDn  : beyondUp

    color c  = isLong ? longCol : shortCol
    int   xr = bar_index + zoneW

    if showSignal
        string head = isLong ? "LONG" : "SHORT"
        string tags = (tradePress ? " ⚡PRESSURE" : "") + (tradeRange ? " ⧉RANGE" : "")
        string txt  = showStars ? head + "  " + str.tostring(sigLvl) + "/" + str.tostring(maxLevels) + tags + "\n" + f_stars(sgScore) + "  " + str.tostring(math.round(sgScore * 10) / 10) + "/10  " + f_tname(sgScore) : head + tags
        aSig := label.new(bar_index, isLong ? low : high, txt, style = isLong ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, color = color.new(c, 6), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt), tooltip = f_tooltip(tradeSide, sgScore, sigMag, sigLvl, sigPress, sigRange))

    if showBasisMark
        aBm := line.new(bar_index, bSafe, xr, bSafe, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(neutralCol, 25), width = 1, style = line.style_dotted)

    if showBoxes
        aSlBox := box.new(bar_index, isLong ? entv : stopv, xr, isLong ? stopv : entv, xloc = xloc.bar_index, bgcolor = color.new(slFill, 80), border_color = color.new(shortCol, 45), border_width = 1)
        aB1    := box.new(bar_index, isLong ? t1 : entv, xr, isLong ? entv : t1, xloc = xloc.bar_index, bgcolor = color.new(tpFill, 78), border_color = color.new(c, 40), border_width = 1)
        aB2    := box.new(bar_index, isLong ? t2 : t1, xr, isLong ? t1 : t2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, bgcolor = color.new(tpFill, 85), border_color = color.new(c, 55), border_width = 1)
        aB3    := box.new(bar_index, isLong ? t3 : t2, xr, isLong ? t2 : t3, xloc = xloc.bar_index, bgcolor = color.new(tpFill, 91), border_color = color.new(c, 70), border_width = 1)

    if showLines
        aEntry := line.new(bar_index, entv, xr, entv, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(c, 0), width = 2, style = line.style_solid)
        aSl    := line.new(bar_index, stopv, xr, stopv, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(shortCol, 10), width = 1, style = line.style_dashed)
        aT1    := line.new(bar_index, t1, xr, t1, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(c, 12), width = 1, style = line.style_solid)
        aT2    := line.new(bar_index, t2, xr, t2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(c, 30), width = 1, style = line.style_solid)
        aT3    := line.new(bar_index, t3, xr, t3, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = color.new(c, 48), width = 1, style = line.style_solid)
        if showLevelLbl
            string dw = isLong ? "LONG" : "SHORT"
            string lm = targetMode == "Pressure Ladder" ? " ⚡" : ""
            aLEntry := label.new(xr, entv, dw + " @ " + str.tostring(entv, format.mintick), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(c, 0), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
            aLSl    := label.new(xr, stopv, "SL @ " + str.tostring(stopv, format.mintick), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(shortCol, 10), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
            aLT1    := label.new(xr, t1, "TP1 " + str.tostring(tR1, "#.#") + "R" + (not na(l1) ? lm : "") + " @ " + str.tostring(t1, format.mintick), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(c, 10), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
            aLT2    := label.new(xr, t2, "TP2 " + str.tostring(tR2, "#.#") + "R" + (not na(l2) ? lm : "") + " @ " + str.tostring(t2, format.mintick), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(c, 26), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))
            aLT3    := label.new(xr, t3, "TP3 " + str.tostring(tR3, "#.#") + "R" + (not na(l3) ? lm : "") + " @ " + str.tostring(t3, format.mintick), xloc = xloc.bar_index, style = label.style_label_left, color = color.new(c, 42), textcolor = color.white, size = f_size(lblSizeOpt))

color  rngStateC   = not haveRange ? txtLo : ctx.failed ? warnCol : ctx.brk == 1 ? longCol : ctx.brk == -1 ? shortCol : ctx.col
string rngLvlTxt   = haveRange ? f_px(ctxHi) + " / " + f_px(ctxLo) : "—"
string rngSizeTxt  = haveRange ? str.tostring(ctxRng / aSafe, "#.#") + " ATR" : "—"
string rngPosTxt   = not haveRange ? "—" : close > ctxHi ? "+" + str.tostring((close - ctxHi) / ctxRng, "#.##") + "x above" : close < ctxLo ? "-" + str.tostring((ctxLo - close) / ctxRng, "#.##") + "x below" : "inside"
color  rngPosC     = not haveRange ? txtLo : close > ctxHi ? shortCol : close < ctxLo ? longCol : txtHi
int    totSess     = w1.sessions + w2.sessions + w3.sessions
int    totBrk      = w1.nBrk + w2.nBrk + w3.nBrk
int    totFail     = w1.nFail + w2.nFail + w3.nFail
string rngStatTxt  = str.tostring(totSess) + " rng · " + str.tostring(totBrk) + " brk"
string rngFailTxt  = totBrk > 0 ? str.tostring(totFail * 100.0 / totBrk, "#") + "% fail" : "—"

f_biasTxt(int d) => d == 1 ? "▲ LONG" : d == -1 ? "▼ SHORT" : "—"
f_biasCol(int d) => d == 1 ? longCol : d == -1 ? shortCol : neutralCol

f_tierWR(int k) =>
    int w  = array.get(tierWin, k)
    int l  = array.get(tierLoss, k)
    int nn = w + l
    [nn > 0 ? w * 100.0 / nn : 0.0, nn]

string ps = f_size(dashSizeOpt)
var int dashRows = 56
var table dash = table.new(f_pos(dashPosOpt), 3, dashRows, frame_color = color.new(panelBorder, 0), frame_width = 1, border_width = 1, border_color = color.new(panelBorder, 30))

f_hdr(table t, int row, string a, string b, string c) =>
    table.cell(t, 0, row, a, text_color = txtHi, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = panelHdr)
    table.cell(t, 1, row, b, text_color = txtLo, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_center, bgcolor = panelHdr)
    table.cell(t, 2, row, c, text_color = txtLo, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = panelHdr)

f_row(table t, int row, string a, string b, color bc, string c, color cc, bool alt) =>
    color bg = alt ? panelBgAlt : panelBg
    table.cell(t, 0, row, a, text_color = txtLo, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = bg)
    table.cell(t, 1, row, b, text_color = bc, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_center, bgcolor = bg)
    table.cell(t, 2, row, c, text_color = cc, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = bg)

f_gRow(table t, int row, string a, float v01, string val, bool alt) =>
    color bg = alt ? panelBgAlt : panelBg
    table.cell(t, 0, row, a, text_color = txtLo, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = bg)
    table.cell(t, 1, row, f_gauge(v01, gaugeLen), text_color = f_gcol(v01), text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_center, bgcolor = bg)
    table.cell(t, 2, row, val, text_color = txtHi, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = bg)

if barstate.islast and showDash
    table.clear(dash, 0, 0, 2, dashRows - 1)
    int r = 0

    f_hdr(dash, r, "STRONG PRESSURE", syminfo.ticker, timeframe.period)
    r += 1
    f_row(dash, r, "Status", statusTxt, statusC, activeTxt, tradeSide == 1 ? longCol : tradeSide == -1 ? shortCol : neutralCol, false)
    r += 1
    f_row(dash, r, "Burst State", burstTxt, upSpike ? shortCol : dnSpike ? longCol : neutralCol, biasTxt, upSpike ? shortCol : dnSpike ? longCol : neutralCol, true)
    r += 1
    f_row(dash, r, "Last Signal", lastTxt, lastSigSide == 1 ? longCol : lastSigSide == -1 ? shortCol : neutralCol, lastScoreTxt, txtHi, false)
    r += 1

    if showPressRows
        f_hdr(dash, r, "PRESSURE CLUSTERS", pressStateTxt, str.tostring(liveRes) + "▲ " + str.tostring(liveSup) + "▼")
        r += 1
        f_row(dash, r, "Resist ▲ (short-liq)", resTxt, resC, resDTxt, resC, false)
        r += 1
        f_row(dash, r, "Support ▼ (long-liq)", supTxt, supC, supDTxt, supC, true)
        r += 1
        f_row(dash, r, "Last Event", evtTxt, evtC, str.tostring(cSweeps) + "sw " + str.tostring(cReclaims) + "rc " + str.tostring(cBreaks) + "bk", txtLo, false)
        r += 1
        f_row(dash, r, "Pressure WR", sPress > 0 ? str.tostring(pressWR, "#") + "%" : "—", sPress > 0 ? (pressWR >= 50 ? goodCol : pressWR >= 38 ? warnCol : badCol) : txtLo, str.tostring(sPress) + " trd", txtLo, true)
        r += 1

    if showRangeRows
        f_hdr(dash, r, "SESSION RANGE", rngStateTxt, haveRange ? ctx.name : "")
        r += 1
        f_row(dash, r, "Cap / Floor", rngLvlTxt, rngStateC, rngSizeTxt, txtHi, false)
        r += 1
        f_row(dash, r, "Price vs Range", rngPosTxt, rngPosC, rngStatTxt, txtLo, true)
        r += 1
        f_row(dash, r, "Range WR", sRange > 0 ? str.tostring(rangeWR, "#") + "%" : "—", sRange > 0 ? (rangeWR >= 50 ? goodCol : rangeWR >= 38 ? warnCol : badCol) : txtLo, str.tostring(sRange) + " trd · " + rngFailTxt, txtLo, false)
        r += 1

    if showGauges
        f_hdr(dash, r, "LIVE SETUP QUALITY", f_biasTxt(liveDir), "VALUE")
        r += 1
        f_gRow(dash, r, "Extension", lvExt, str.tostring(liveMag, "#.##") + " ATR", false)
        r += 1
        f_gRow(dash, r, "Stack", lvStk, str.tostring(liveLvl) + "/" + str.tostring(maxLevels), true)
        r += 1
        f_gRow(dash, r, "Exhaustion", lvExh, str.tostring(rsi, "#.#") + " RSI", false)
        r += 1
        f_gRow(dash, r, "Rejection", lvRej, str.tostring(liveRej * 100, "#") + "%", true)
        r += 1
        f_gRow(dash, r, "Trend Fit", lvTrd, str.tostring(nz(basisSlope) / aSafe, "#.##"), false)
        r += 1
        f_gRow(dash, r, "Calm Regime", lvCal, str.tostring(nz(atrPct), "#") + " pct", true)
        r += 1
        f_gRow(dash, r, "Rev Room", lvRoom, str.tostring(math.abs(close - bSafe) / aSafe, "#.#") + " ATR", false)
        r += 1
        f_gRow(dash, r, "⚡ Pressure", lvPrs, liveDir == -1 ? (hitRes ? "IN CLUSTER" : resDTxt) : (hitSup ? "IN CLUSTER" : supDTxt), true)
        r += 1
        f_gRow(dash, r, "⧉ Range", lvRng, haveRange ? rngPosTxt : "n/a", false)
        r += 1
        table.cell(dash, 0, r, "SCORE", text_color = txtHi, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = panelHdr)
        table.cell(dash, 1, r, f_gauge(lvScore / 10.0, gaugeLen), text_color = f_gcol(lvScore / 10.0), text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_center, bgcolor = panelHdr)
        table.cell(dash, 2, r, str.tostring(math.round(lvScore * 10) / 10) + "  " + f_stars(lvScore), text_color = txtHi, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = panelHdr)
        r += 1

    f_hdr(dash, r, "PERFORMANCE", "VALUE", "DETAIL")
    r += 1
    f_row(dash, r, "Win Rate", str.tostring(winRate, "#.#") + "%", txtHi, str.tostring(sClosed) + " trd", txtHi, false)
    r += 1
    f_row(dash, r, "Profit Factor", pfTxt, pfC, f_signedR(avgR) + "/t", avgR >= 0 ? goodCol : badCol, true)
    r += 1
    f_row(dash, r, "Total R", f_signedR(sR), sR >= 0 ? goodCol : badCol, bestDir, bestDir == "LONG" ? longCol : bestDir == "SHORT" ? shortCol : neutralCol, false)
    r += 1
    f_row(dash, r, "Long / Short WR", str.tostring(longWR, "#") + "% / " + str.tostring(shortWR, "#") + "%", txtHi, str.tostring(sLong) + "L " + str.tostring(sShort) + "S", txtLo, true)
    r += 1
    f_row(dash, r, "Streak", streakTxt, sStreak >= 0 ? goodCol : badCol, "W" + str.tostring(sMaxWin) + "/L" + str.tostring(sMaxLos), txtHi, false)
    r += 1

    if showHeatRow
        f_row(dash, r, "TP1/2/3 · SL", str.tostring(tp1Rate, "#") + "/" + str.tostring(tp2Rate, "#") + "/" + str.tostring(tp3Rate, "#"), txtHi, str.tostring(slRate, "#") + "%", badCol, true)
        r += 1

    if showMtf
        f_hdr(dash, r, "MTF BURST BIAS", timeframe.period, mtfTf2 + " · " + mtfTf3)
        r += 1
        f_row(dash, r, "Bias", f_biasTxt(mtfBias), f_biasCol(mtfBias), f_biasTxt(b2) + " " + f_biasTxt(b3), b2 + b3 > 0 ? longCol : b2 + b3 < 0 ? shortCol : neutralCol, false)
        r += 1

    if showTiers
        f_hdr(dash, r, "WIN RATE BY STRENGTH", "WR", "n")
        r += 1
        for k = 4 to 1
            [twr, tn] = f_tierWR(k)
            string star = k == 4 ? "★★★★" : k == 3 ? "★★★" : k == 2 ? "★★" : "★"
            color tc = tn == 0 ? txtLo : twr >= 45 ? goodCol : twr >= 33 ? warnCol : badCol
            bool alt = k % 2 == 0
            color bg = alt ? panelBg : panelBgAlt
            table.cell(dash, 0, r, star, text_color = warnCol, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = bg)
            table.cell(dash, 1, r, tn > 0 ? str.tostring(twr, "#.#") + "%" : "—", text_color = tc, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_center, bgcolor = bg)
            table.cell(dash, 2, r, str.tostring(tn), text_color = txtHi, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = bg)
            r += 1

    if showRecent
        f_hdr(dash, r, "LAST TRADES", "EXIT", "R")
        r += 1
        int hn = array.size(recentOut)
        if hn > 0
            int shown = math.min(hn, 6)
            for i = 0 to shown - 1
                string o  = array.get(recentOut, i)
                float rv  = array.size(recentR) > i ? array.get(recentR, i) : 0.0
                color oc  = rv > 0 ? goodCol : badCol
                bool alt2 = i % 2 == 1
                color bg2 = alt2 ? panelBgAlt : panelBg
                table.cell(dash, 0, r, "#" + str.tostring(i + 1), text_color = txtLo, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_left, bgcolor = bg2)
                table.cell(dash, 1, r, o, text_color = oc, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_center, bgcolor = bg2)
                table.cell(dash, 2, r, f_signedR(rv), text_color = oc, text_size = ps, text_halign = text.align_right, bgcolor = bg2)
                r += 1

bool alertOk  = f_tier(sgScore) >= alertStars
bool upXtreme = upPeak and upLvlPk >= maxLevels
bool dnXtreme = dnPeak and dnLvlPk >= maxLevels
bool nearStrongRes = not na(nearResD) and nearResD <= 0.5 and nz(nearResSc) >= 7.0
bool nearStrongSup = not na(nearSupD) and nearSupD <= 0.5 and nz(nearSupSc) >= 7.0
